root_cause.text: mshv_handle_gpa_intercept() unconditionally attempted to remap pages for all faults on movable memory regions without validating the access type against region permissions, causing a successful but permission-unchanged remap that immediately re-faults, creating an infinite loop.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit checks for write access against HV_MAP_GPA_WRITABLE and execute access against HV_MAP_GPA_EXECUTABLE before processing; the commit message states "When a guest writes to a read-only region, the remap succeeds but the region remains read-only, causing immediate re-fault and spinning the vCPU indefinitely."
